about: Recorded pull-request history of the comptoir repository, replayed with `harvest github --from`. The agent PR is opened from a human account: only the trailer of its commits marks it. `result` is the whole harvest the replay must print; `noise` lists what the history holds that must not count.

evidence.author: cmartin
evidence.text: a field added to a contract stays optional for one release before it joins `required`.
evidence.group_key: rule:added before contract field joins optional release stays
